# Introduction to Building Apps

Using BigCommerce’s powerful APIs, SDKs, and toolkits, developers can build apps that are installable on BigCommerce stores. Once approved, apps can be sold (or made available free of charge) to all BigCommerce store owners on the [App Marketplace](https://www.bigcommerce.com/apps/). This is the first article in a comprehensive developer’s guide to building BigCommerce apps. It provides a brief, high-level introduction for developers new to the platform. If you already have experience developing for BigCommerce, skip ahead to the [app development process](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/introduction#app-development-process) or start with the [quick start tutorial](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/quick-start).

If you are interested in building Catalyst-compatible apps or integrations, see [Building Catalyst-compatible apps and integrations](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/guide/building-catalyst-compatible-apps-and-integrations).

## About BigCommerce apps

Apps are discovered, displayed, and managed on BigCommerce stores in the following ways.

### Discovery

Approved apps are listed on the [App Marketplace](https://www.bigcommerce.com/apps/) for store owners to browse, search, and install.

![App Marketplace](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_fern-files/_img/05c3b54c12861a431fa4ba63e8763cd260655c7a6b922f0564ab6a96e506cd7e.webp)

### Management

Apps installed on a store are managed in the store’s control panel under **Apps** > **My Apps**. Here, store users can launch or uninstall the app. Draft apps that you are still developing appear under **Apps** > **Develop**.

![App Management](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_fern-files/_img/39274eb3126444098235ebd71f303389c035d4e593a140d872bf9ab98b96d578.webp)

### Display

When a store user launches an app, BigCommerce makes a request to the app’s Load callback URL and displays the app’s UI in an iFrame.

![App Display](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_fern-files/_img/93a05c2f0d7d8ebf8c6b2fbec868d0127dcc830026dfab4009d3cb92500996fd.webp)

## App development process

Building and publishing an app follows these steps:

1. **Get a store and a Developer Portal account.** You need a BigCommerce store to test in and a [Developer Portal](https://build.bigcommerce.com/) account to register apps. You can use any store you own, and partners can also [create a sandbox store](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/sandboxes).
2. **Build a draft app.** Start with our [sample app](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/quick-start) and register it in the Developer Portal. For steps, see [Beginning app development](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/guide).
3. **Test your app.** Install the draft app in your store and confirm the install, load, and uninstall flows work. See [Testing your app](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/guide/testing-your-app).
4. **Become a partner.** Publishing an app to the App Marketplace requires a BigCommerce partnership. See [Becoming a partner](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/becoming-a-partner).
5. **Check the requirements.** Review the [approval requirements](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/guide/approval-requirements) before you submit.
6. **Submit your app for approval.** The Marketplace team reviews your app and sends you feedback until it meets the requirements. See [Publishing apps](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/guide/publishing-apps).
7. **Publish.** After approval, your app is published and listed on the App Marketplace. See [Types of apps](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/integrations/apps/guide/types-of-apps) for the states an app can be in.

To get help from other developers, [join the Developer Community](https://support.bigcommerce.com/s/community). For inspiration on what to build, see the [App Marketplace](https://www.bigcommerce.com/apps/).
